node.title: Re^3: Overriding Global Variables
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
the "debug" function is enabled or disabled in accordance to the module that uses it

I see, in that case I would [id://1203783|concur] with [karlgoethebier] and I think an OO approach is probably best - each module can get an object with an individual debug flag. And looking into existing logging modules, as [1nickt] [id://1203781|said], makes sense before you re-invent that wheel.
